description: Dispatches a physical click to a resolved page target. If it triggers a page alert, it is handled without creating an interactive dialog and the success feedback reports the alert message. If it opens a confirm, prompt, or beforeunload dialog, the action returns its dialog id and directs the caller to Page.handleDialog; if it activates a file chooser, the native chooser is cancelled automatically and the prompt directs the caller to direct File.handleChooser injection.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the click target.

selector.description: Fallback CSS selector for the click target.

id.description: Preferred canonical element ID from DOM.getAXTree.

x.description: Fallback X coordinate for coordinate-based clicking.

y.description: Fallback Y coordinate for coordinate-based clicking.

force.description: Dispatch even when the resolved element is occluded. Normal browser hit testing still applies, so delivery to the requested target is not guaranteed. Ignored for coordinate-based clicks.

clickCount.description: Number of clicks to dispatch: 1 or 2.

purpose.description: Describe the intended effect of this click, e.g., opening a menu, selecting a result, or submitting a form

target.description: Target identity used for the click.

resolvedBy.description: Actor or resolution mode that selected the target.

recoveredTarget.description: Snapshot details used when a stale target was recovered.

point.description: CSS-pixel point used for the click.

resolutionSource.description: Target resolution route used by the action.

dialog.description: Interactive native dialog returned by this click; handled page alerts are not returned here.

id.description: ID of an interactive native dialog returned for Page.handleDialog.

message.description: Dialog message supplied by the page.

defaultValue.description: Default value for a prompt dialog.

truncated.description: Whether native dialog text was truncated.

observation.description: Facts directly observed by the Action or returned by its declared result schema.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.
